mechanism: Retrieval over a vetted EDI knowledge base inside an educator chatbot
evidence_scope: Unlike generic chat interfaces, GenEDIt provides a tailored UI and workflow, and embeds retrieval over a vetted EDI knowledge base.
evidence_role: We present GenEDIt, a purpose-built, LLM-backed chatbot that helps educators weave EDI into SE education artefacts without altering intended learning outcomes.
